answer_1.quote: Bilingual lexicon induction (BLI). The task of BLI aims to induce a bilingual lexicon (i.e., word translation) from comparable monolingual corpora (e.g., Wikipedia in different languages).
answer_1.outputs: bilingual word pairs as the induced lexicon
